last.verdict: Investors looked past the guidance cut to a Q3 beat and a 2027 margin recovery.

reasons.label: Q3 profit beat
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $0.66 and record $8.4B revenue (up 21%) beat analyst estimates.

reasons.label: 2027 margin recovery
reasons.text: Management sees meaningful margin expansion in 2027 even if fuel stays high.

reasons.label: Fuel-driven guidance cut
reasons.text: 2026 EPS outlook cut to $2.60–$2.85 as Q4 fuel nears $4.55 a gallon.

story: Fuel costs have driven the last few reports. In April, a weak Q2 outlook sent shares down 3.8%. In July, a beat and a lowered full-year outlook sent them down about 5%. October's report beat estimates and the stock rose.
